name: foclient-monorepo
description: FOCLIENT — Plataforma SaaS Multi-tenant (Frontend React + Backend Fastify/Prisma/Neon/Baileys WhatsApp)

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
